title: Image and video to 3d animation and pose Blender plugin.
author: KitsuMateAi
selftext:
Working with inputs being both photo realistic or stylized artworks.

I created it for my internal purposes for quick pose drafts and animations based on existing videos and poses.

It expanded to something more than just tech demo and list of helpful scripts. Getting to size of full fledged plugin.

Not sure if there is a demand for such solution.

If there will be high engagement on this post, I'll assume y'all interested in it and opensource it to make it freely available.  


After fixing bugs that is.

comments.author: Vortexneonlight
comments.body: Dude!!!, that's amazing, please share it, is it local or cloud, does it requires heavey compute?

replies.author: KitsuMateAi
replies.body:
It is fully local.

Currently I implemeted two backends, MediaPipe (worse quality, ultra fast even on cpu but working only with photorealistic images),

And sam3 backend, superior quality but slower, plugin also have button to allow to install pytorch backend which is unfirtunatelly needed.

Will work on modest cpu in about 30s-1min per pose if model is already loaded.
On gpu (3070 laptop), it took about 5s-10s pose.

Model loading takes some time, so first invocation takes some time.
